objects.name: Detection technique coverage: azure-ad-oauth-application-consent-granted-by-user
objects.description: The following analytic detects when a user in an Azure AD environment grants consent to an OAuth application. It leverages Azure AD audit logs to identify events where users approve application consents. This activity is significant as it can expose organizational data to third-party applications, a common tactic used by malicious actors to gain unauthorized access.
